modeDescription.full_erase: Requests a forced erase of the entire target storage, then writes all packaged partition images, the partition table, and boot components.
modeDescription.keep_data: Requests data preservation and skips writing udisk, private, and reserve while writing the remaining packaged partition images, the partition table, and boot components.
modeDescription.partition_erase: Erases according to the device's partition layout and storage type, potentially affecting partitions without images, then writes all packaged partition images, the partition table, and boot components.
modeDescription.partition: Skips the separate erase command, writes only the selected partitions with packaged images, and still sends the partition table and boot components.
